comments.en:
If the printer self-test page says HBPL but the printer won't work with Linux HBPL2 drivers, then it might be HBPL version 1. This HBPLv1 driver is used for printers like the Xerox Phaser 6000B or Xerox Phaser 6010N which has added functionality compared to the Dell-1250c.

You can test your printer with this option using examples seen in man pages hbpl1.1, hbpl1-wrapper.1 (these are found in package foo2zjs).

This entry allows you to use any printer which understands HBPL1 (compatible to the Xerox Phaser 6010N) with Foomatic, at least with the basic options. See your printer's manual to know whether your printer supports HBPL1.

Use this only for setting up your printer if your printer is not explicitly listed in the Foomatic database.

This printer is supported by the foo2hbpl1 open software printer driver with extra -z1 options.

If you use this entry to set up your printer, note that not all features of your printer will be supported and that the options offered to you do not all necessarily apply to your printer.
